entities.summary: Mario Casariego y Acevedo, CRS was a Spanish-born Guatemalan Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Santiago de Guatemala from 1964 until his death in 1983. He was elevated to the cardinalate in 1969. He was a member of the Somaschi Fathers.
